notes.title: Antioma Hotfix 3
notes.content:
A bit more time has passed, and we've fixed a few more bugs.
[p align="start"]Changelog:

Removed a placeholder voice line from one of the objects.

Fixed a softlock that prevented progress after playing Bone Poker.

Fixed minor visual and logical bugs.
[p align="start"]Thank you for sending us bug reports. Keep up the good work!

notes.title: Antioma Hotfix 2
notes.content:
We are carefully watching streams of the game and reading your feedback, so here's another hotfix with minor improvements:


Fixed an issue where the Rat minigame was impossible to win

Simplified the Bee minigame

Fixed localization errors

Fixed issues in one of the scenes

Continue playing the game to find other issues we have to fix :)

notes.title: Antioma Hotfix 1
notes.content:
It's been almost two days since the release of Antioma. We've been watching streams, playthroughs, and gathering your feedback. So, here's the first small hotfix addressing the issues you've already spotted.
[p align="start"]Patch Notes:

Fixed incorrect dialogue being assigned to the wrong characters.

Fixed various visual glitches.

Fixed issues in minigames that could lead to softlocks.

Fixed a rare bug preventing interaction with certain objects.
[p align="start"]This won't be the last hotfix—we're still working on more improvements. Please keep sending your bug reports if you find anything!

notes.title: Antioma Demo — Release Patch
notes.content:
Antioma launches in just two days, and we're rolling out a major update to the demo! It now fully represents the final quality of the game, complete with new music, characters' voices, and professional translations.
[p align="start"]Help Kiddo escape from the hospital on his Birthday!
[p align="start"]A note for players who are getting the full version: To avoid potential issues with transferring your save data (we've tested everything, but we can't rule out all risks), we advise you to either:

Wait two days and start fresh with the full version.

Or start a new game after the full version is out.
[p align="start"]If you're feeling adventurous, you can always try to transfer your save, we did our best to make it work! :)
[p align="start"]Changes:

Added 5 new music tracks.

All characters now have voices, and the most important cutscenes feature complete voice acting.

Updated localization: All translations have been done manually and now match the languages available in the full game.

Updated the main menu.

Fixed various bugs.
[p align="start"]See you on September 10th!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and the first patch for Antioma Demo!
notes.content:
We’ve rolled out the first patch for the Antioma demo! In preparation for Steam Next Fest, we’ve polished and expanded the game so returning players can enjoy a bit more content, while newcomers get an even smoother experience. Here’s what’s new:

- Added a cutscene at the end of the demo

- Added a bit of music

- Added localization for 4 more languages

- Added credits

- Added a dedicated error-reporting option

- Added/updated several sound effects

- Added achievements (try getting them all!)

- Minor fixes

The update is already available for download — jump back in and check it out!
